parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarDB instance on which the application depends.

parameters.name: PolarFsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Polarlakebase instance.

parameters.name: Quotas
parameters.description: The details of the quota rules.

sub_parameters.name: AccessTTL
sub_parameters.description: The time to live (TTL) for the access time. Unit: seconds.

sub_parameters.name: ChangeTTL
sub_parameters.description: The TTL for the change time. Unit: seconds.

sub_parameters.name: Description
sub_parameters.description: The description of the resource quota.

sub_parameters.name: Enabled
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. Valid values:

- **True**: The rule immediately applies to new items. This is the default value.

- **False**: The rule does not apply to new items.

sub_parameters.name: Exclude
sub_parameters.description:
The rule to exclude specific paths from matching.

- A path pattern that starts with a forward slash (/). Supports glob syntax, including `*`, `?`, and `**`.

sub_parameters.name: FileCountLimit
sub_parameters.description: The limit on the number of files for a user in the directory.

sub_parameters.name: Include
sub_parameters.description:
The wildcard pattern to match paths.

- A path pattern that starts with a forward slash (/). Supports glob syntax, including `*`, `?`, and `**`.

sub_parameters.name: Priority
sub_parameters.description: The priority of the quota rule.

sub_parameters.name: SizeLimit
sub_parameters.description:
The total size limit for files in the directory. Unit: GB.

- Note: The value must be at least 1 GB.
